card: Adds a section to doc/developer-notes.md specifying how contributors should document tests written to kill mutation testing mutants. Contributors are instructed to provide a minimal diff in the commit message or pull request description and link to MutantHub to prevent duplicate work and allow reviewers to verify test failures. This is a developer documentation update with no code changes.
changed_since_previous: The diff is now present, showing specific guidance to include a minimal diff example, advice against killing equivalent or unproductive mutants, and instructions to register and link surviving mutants on MutantHub.
evidence: PR description: 'The main motivation is to facilitate review, avoid duplicated work (different PRs addressing the same mutants), and go towards an automated setup to check it.'
problem: Contributors adding tests to kill surviving mutants currently lack a standardized way to describe the mutation, making review harder, risking duplicated effort across contributors targeting the same mutants, and complicating future automation.

risk.why: This is purely developer-facing documentation with no impact on binary behavior or code execution.

summary: Adds guidelines to doc/developer-notes.md on documenting tests written to kill mutation testing mutants. It specifies providing a minimal diff of the targeted mutation in commit messages or pull request descriptions and referencing the mutant on MutantHub.
